usage: Chilli is a seasoning used to add spiciness to food.
People in Hong Kong often eat food with chilli sauce.
Chilli can sometimes feel very intense on the mouth, so eat it carefully.
When buying chillies, choose ones that are fresh and brightly coloured.
There are many different types of chilli — some are very spicy, others are milder.
